INSERT INTO git_sync_ci_test_check
            (workspace_id, github_workspace_id, head_sha, head_ref, repo_url,
             repo_resource_path, check_run_id,
             created_at, concluded, conclusion, concluded_at, github_posted)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $7, $6, now(), false, NULL, NULL, false)
         ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, repo_resource_path, head_sha) DO UPDATE SET
            github_workspace_id = EXCLUDED.github_workspace_id,
            head_ref = EXCLUDED.head_ref,
            repo_url = EXCLUDED.repo_url,
            repo_resource_path = EXCLUDED.repo_resource_path,
            check_run_id = GREATEST(git_sync_ci_test_check.check_run_id, EXCLUDED.check_run_id),
            created_at = now(),
            concluded = false,
            conclusion = NULL,
            concluded_at = NULL,
            github_posted = false
